name: yeyi-translator
description: 页译：支持 Chrome / Edge、DeepSeek / OpenAI 的整页翻译扩展

scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests manifest.json package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests manifest.json package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.test: npm run test:regression && node tests/browser/run.mjs && node --test tests/browser/features.test.mjs && npm run test:shortcuts && npm run test:names && npm run test:settings
scripts.test:regression: node --test tests/regression/api-connection.test.mjs tests/regression/inline-code.test.mjs tests/regression/translation-order.test.mjs tests/regression/batching.test.mjs tests/regression/chinese-skip.test.mjs tests/regression/cache.test.mjs tests/regression/cache-priority.test.mjs tests/regression/visibility.test.mjs tests/regression/scroll-stability.test.mjs tests/regression/translation-font.test.mjs tests/regression/dynamic-render.test.mjs tests/regression/reasoning.test.mjs tests/regression/japanese-translation.test.mjs
scripts.test:reasoning: node --test tests/regression/reasoning.test.mjs && node --test --test-name-pattern=推理级别 tests/browser/features.test.mjs
scripts.test:fonts: node --test tests/regression/translation-font.test.mjs tests/regression/dynamic-render.test.mjs && node --test --test-name-pattern="中文字体开关|保存字体开关|中文字体优化兼容汉字" tests/browser/features.test.mjs
